Package model

Class User

java.lang.Object
model.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Stock
public class User extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an application user who owns albums and maintains a tag library.

A User stores a username, password, a list of Albums, and a personal list of Tag types and values. Users can log in, view their album library, and serialize their data to disk.

This class is Serializable; user data is saved in individual .dat files inside the application's data folder. A static list of all users is maintained in-memory and restored on application startup.

  • Method Details

    • addTag

      public void addTag(Tag newTag)
      Adds a new tag definition to the user's tag list.

      Behavior:

      • If the tag's type exists, the method checks whether its value already exists.
      • A (type, null) entry is always ensured to exist.
      • If the new value is unique, the full tag is added.
      Parameters:
      newTag - the tag to add
